definition_zh: 金丝雀；淡黄色；告密者（俚语）
definition_en: a small yellow songbird kept as a pet; also a light yellow color, or in slang, an informer
core_image: 笼中一只淡黄小鸟引颈高歌：歌声既是报晓的美妙声音，也是报警的信号
scene: 矿井口，矿工拎起鸟笼又看了看天色，才带队下井。The canary stopped singing, and the miners scrambled back up.
sceneCN: 这里 canary 是「金丝雀」（第 1 个义项：作报警用的笼养小鸟）；句意是金丝雀停止鸣叫后，矿工们急忙爬回井上。

collocations.phrase: a canary in a coal mine
collocations.zh: 矿井里的金丝雀（预警信号）
像金丝雀一样招供（俚语）

derivatives.zh: 专有名词，义为「加那利群岛」，金丝雀原产地的地名来源
复合名词，义为「草芦」，一种原产该地区的草
复合名词，义为「金丝雀黄；淡黄色」

senses.title: A small yellow songbird
senses.definition: a small finch native to the Canary Islands, bred in cages for its bright color and song
senses.definitionCN: 原产加那利群岛的小型雀鸟，因羽色明黄、鸣声婉转而被笼养繁育
senses.example: The canary trilled from its brass cage by the window.
senses.exampleCN: 金丝雀在窗边的黄铜鸟笼里婉转啼鸣。
senses.why: The word began as the place name: the bird is named after its island home.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初是地名：这种鸟以它的原产岛屿命名。

senses.title: A warning signal sensitive to danger
senses.definition: a person, animal, or indicator whose visible reaction gives early warning of hidden danger
senses.definitionCN: 以明显反应率先暴露隐性危险的人、动物或指标
senses.example: Coral reefs are the canary in the coal mine for ocean health.
senses.exampleCN: 珊瑚礁是海洋健康状况的预警金丝雀。
senses.why: Miners literally carried canaries into coal mines because the birds collapsed before humans did.
senses.whyCN: 矿工真的曾把金丝雀带进煤矿，因为鸟比人先倒下，可作预警。

senses.title: A light yellow color
senses.definition: a bright, light yellow like the bird's feathers
senses.definitionCN: 像这种鸟羽毛一样的明亮浅黄色
senses.example: She painted the kitchen canary yellow.
senses.exampleCN: 她把厨房刷成了金丝雀黄。
senses.why: The bird's name colors everything that shares its yellow.
senses.whyCN: 鸟名把这种黄色辐射给了所有同色的东西。

senses.title: An informer
senses.definition: slang for someone who betrays secrets to the authorities, from the bird's constant singing
senses.definitionCN: 俚语，指向当局出卖秘密的人，取自这种鸟不停歌唱的特性
senses.example: The gang discovered a canary in their ranks.
senses.exampleCN: 团伙发现自己内部出了告密者。
senses.why: A bird that never stops singing is a perfect image for someone who cannot keep quiet.
senses.whyCN: 一只叫个不停的鸟，正是「守不住嘴的人」的完美意象。

intro.en: Canary is the bird named after the Canary Islands, whose Latin name refers not to songbirds but to dogs.
intro.cn: canary 是以加那利群岛命名的鸟，而群岛的拉丁名指的并不是鸣禽，而是狗。

items.en: The root *ḱwṓn, dog, runs through the whole Indo-European dog-word family.
items.cn: 词根 *ḱwṓn（狗）贯穿整个印欧语系的「狗」词族。

items.en: Latin canarius meant of dogs, and Insulae Canariae, the Islands of the Dogs, was the Roman name for the archipelago.
items.cn: 拉丁语 canarius 意为「与狗有关的」，罗马人称该群岛为 Insulae Canariae（狗之群岛）。

items.en: Iberian sailors rendered the island name as Canaria and applied canario to the islands' small birds.
items.cn: 伊比利亚水手把岛名转写为 Canaria，并把 canario 用到群岛上的小型鸟类。

items.en: English canary bird first named the bird in the sixteenth century, later shortened to canary.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语先以 canary bird 称呼此鸟，后简化为 canary。

items.en: The yellow color sense appeared in the seventeenth century, applied to wine and cloth from the islands.
items.cn: 十七世纪出现黄色义，先用于群岛产的葡萄酒和布料。

items.en: The coal-mine warning practice gave the figurative sense, and American slang added the informer sense.
items.cn: 矿井预警的实践催生比喻义，美国俚语又添了告密者义。

note.en: Canary shares its dog root with a small word family and is easy to tangle with similarly spelled bird names.
note.cn: canary 的「狗」词根衍生出一小组词族，且容易与拼写相近的鸟类名混淆。

entries.definition: Of or like a dog, from the same Latin canis root.
entries.definitionCN: 犬的；犬齿，同出拉丁语 canis 词根。

entries.definition: A doghouse, from French chenil, ultimately the same dog root.
entries.definitionCN: 狗窝，经法语 chenil 上溯到同一「狗」词根。

entries.definition: A factory for canning food; only one letter from canary but from can.
entries.definitionCN: 罐头厂，与 canary 仅差一个字母，但源自 can（罐）。

entries.definition: A small open sandwich; spelled close but from a couch root.
entries.definitionCN: 小开胃点心，拼写相近但源自「沙发」一词根。

entries.definition: The bird family the canary belongs to.
entries.definitionCN: 雀科，canary 所属的鸟类家族。

entries.definition: A guard or watcher that gives warning, the human figure of the canary role.
entries.definitionCN: 哨兵、守望者，是 canary 预警角色的人格化版本。

entries.definition: A leading indicator of trends, figurative like the mine canary.
entries.definitionCN: 领头羊、风向标，与矿井金丝雀同为比喻性指标。

entries.definition: One who betrays secrets, the plain word behind the slang sense.
entries.definitionCN: 告密者，是俚语义项背后的平实用词。

entries.definition: In political metaphor, the aggressive opposite of the small, warning songbird.
entries.definitionCN: 政治隐喻中的鹰派，与示警的小鸣禽形成象征性对照。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the island-of-dogs origin and the mine-shaft image.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「狗之群岛」词源与矿井画面的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Place first: Canary Islands, from Latin Insulae Canariae, the Islands of the Dogs.
normal.cn: 地名在先：加那利群岛源自拉丁语 Insulae Canariae（狗之群岛）。

normal.en: Same root: canary, canine, and kennel all descend from the dog word canis.
normal.cn: 同根记忆：canary、canine、kennel 都出自「狗」词 canis。

normal.en: Metaphor: a canary in a coal mine is the fixed phrase for an early-warning indicator.
normal.cn: 比喻义：固定说法「a canary in a coal mine」即「早期预警指标」。

normal.en: Color: canary yellow is the standard name for bright light yellow in fashion and design.
normal.cn: 颜色：canary yellow 是时尚与设计中明亮浅黄的标准色名。

normal.en: Slang hook: sing like a canary, to confess everything, links the bird's song to betrayal.
normal.cn: 俚语钩子：sing like a canary（全盘招供）把鸟鸣与告密连在一起。

abstract.en: A tiny yellow bird going quiet in the dark: everyone's alarm bell with feathers.
abstract.cn: 黑暗中一只突然噤声的小黄鸟：长着羽毛的警报器。

abstract.en: A swell of yellow paint across a gray wall, the room suddenly singing.
abstract.cn: 一抹淡黄刷过灰墙，整个房间顿时唱起歌来。

abstract.en: Dogs on a wild beach, named forever into an island, then into a bird.
abstract.cn: 野滩上的狗群：名字永远留给了岛，又从岛转给了鸟。

examples.en: Rising insurance claims were the canary that warned of the building's structural trouble.
examples.cn: 保险索赔的上升是预警这栋楼结构隐患的金丝雀。

examples.en: He kept a canary that sang every morning outside his studio.
examples.cn: 他养了一只金丝雀，每天清晨在画室外鸣唱。

examples.en: Under pressure, the suspect sang like a canary.
examples.cn: 在压力之下，嫌疑人对一切都招供了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克内瑞」——笼子可（克）内部（内）日日（瑞）有歌声，说的就是笼养的金丝雀；联想煤井里的小黄鸟一停叫大家就撤，淡黄色的小身躯格外醒目。

root: 以地名 Canary Islands（加那利群岛）命名；岛名出自拉丁语 Insulae Canariae（狗之群岛，因岛上多大型野狗），词根为拉丁语 canis（狗），可上溯至印欧词根 *ḱwṓn。因此「金丝雀」其实是「狗之鸟」，与 canine（犬的）同根。俚语「告密者」由其不停鸣唱的特征引申而来。

sensesIntro.en: From the island-named songbird the word grows into an early-warning metaphor, a color name, and slang for an informer.
sensesIntro.cn: 从以岛命名的鸣禽出发，词义生长为预警的比喻、颜色名称以及指告密者的俚语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small yellow bird whose song and silence both carry messages.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只淡黄小鸟，它的歌声与沉默都传递着讯息。

branches.en: THE CAGE: the literal finch bred for color and song.
branches.cn: 鸟笼：字面义的雀鸟，为羽色与歌声而繁育。

branches.en: THE MINE: the bird that collapses first and saves the miners.
branches.cn: 矿井：先倒下却救了矿工的鸟。

branches.en: THE PAINTBOX: the yellow that borrowed the bird's name.
branches.cn: 颜料盒：借走鸟名的黄色。

branches.en: THE INTERROGATION: the singer who cannot keep quiet.
branches.cn: 审讯室：守不住嘴的歌唱者。

branches.en: THE MESSAGE: both senses turn the bird's voice into information others must heed.
branches.cn: 讯息：两个义项都把鸟鸣转译成他人必须重视的信息。

intro.en: Canary is a place-name turned common noun; its derivational life sits in compounds and the dog-root family.
intro.cn: canary 是由地名转成的普通名词；其派生活动体现在复合词与「狗」词根家族中。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root canis, dog, extends far beyond the bird into anatomy and everyday dog words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 canis（狗）的延伸远不止这只鸟，还进入解剖学和日常犬类词汇。

items.example: Canis familiaris, the species name of the dog

items.exampleCN: 狗之群岛（加那利群岛的拉丁名）。

items.meaning: noun-forming ending in the borrowed bird name
items.meaningCN: 借入鸟名中的名词性词尾
items.exampleCN: canary 由西班牙语 canario 转来。

items.meaning: a grass native to the Canary region
items.meaningCN: 草芦（原产加那利地区的草）

items.structure: French doublet of the same root
items.example: the dog sleeps in its kennel
He sang like a canary at the trial.
items.exampleCN: 他在庭上竹筒倒豆子般招了供。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 当心恶犬（庞贝马赛克铭文）。
